ISSUE_KIND: streetlight
ISSUE: Missing and broken light fixtures on a twin-arm ornamental streetlight
DETAILS: The photo shows a damaged twin-arm ornamental streetlight fixture against a clear sky, where one side is missing its light fixture entirely (leaving exposed wires) and the other side has an exposed bulb missing its protective globe. The user note adds no details.
ORGANIZATION: New York City Department of Transportation
DEPARTMENT: Division of Traffic Operations
WHY: The pin is located on West 86th Street in Manhattan, New York City. The New York City Department of Transportation (NYC DOT) is responsible for maintaining all municipal streetlights on city streets throughout the five boroughs.
COVERAGE_QUOTE: "NYC DOT maintains nearly 400,000 streetlights throughout New York City."
COVERAGE_URL: https://www.nyc.gov/html/dot/html/infrastructure/streetlights.shtml
